description.en: Download public videos from supported social platforms through independent Apify Actors. SwiftBiu only provides the extension runtime, network transport, and local file save APIs.
description.zh: 通过独立的 Apify Actor 下载支持平台的公开视频。SwiftBiu 仅提供扩展运行环境、网络请求和本地文件保存能力。

domains.purpose: Start and monitor the selected third-party Apify video downloader Actor and read its result dataset.

description.en: Your own Apify token. It is stored by SwiftBiu as a secure configuration value and sent only to api.apify.com.
description.zh: 你自己的 Apify Token。由 SwiftBiu 作为安全配置保存，仅发送给 api.apify.com。

description.en: The YouTube Actor creates one downloadable file in this preferred quality.
description.zh: YouTube Actor 会按该首选画质生成一个可下载文件。

description.en: Passed to Apify as maxTotalChargeUsd. The run is capped to one paid dataset item as an additional safety guard.
description.zh: 通过 maxTotalChargeUsd 传给 Apify，并额外把单次付费 Dataset 结果限制为 1 条。

description.en: Optional default save folder. If not configured, the plugin asks you to choose a folder before saving.
description.zh: 可选默认保存目录。未配置时，插件会在保存前要求选择目录。

description.en: Detect the selected video platform, run a third-party Apify Actor, and save the returned media locally.
description.zh: 识别选中链接的平台，运行第三方 Apify Actor，并把返回的媒体保存到本地。
